mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the difference between the present value of cash inflows and those of the cash outflows all discounted at the cost of capital."
Net Present Value (NPV) is defined as the difference between the present value of cash inflows and those of the cash outflows all discounted at the cost of capital.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the event can never take place."
A probability of zero means that the event can never take place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the actual amounts of money changing hands whereas real cash flows are the purchasing power equivalents of the actual cash flows."
Money cash flows are the actual amounts of money changing hands whereas real cash flows are the purchasing power equivalents of the actual cash flows.
fib: ______ is defined as the period, usually expressed in years, which it takes for the projects net cash inflows to recoup the original investment.
Payback period is defined as the period, usually expressed in years, which it takes for the projects net cash inflows to recoup the original investment.
______ is the benefit foregone by choosing one opportunity instead of the next best alternative.
An opportunity cost is the benefit foregone by choosing one opportunity instead of the next best alternative.
